edges.reason: The Owned constructor assigns ownership from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before setting newOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable for authorisation.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating ownership.
The pending newOwner state variable gates who may accept ownership.
transferOwnership stores the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor initialises the symbol state variable.
Constructor initialises the name state variable.
Constructor initialises the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the fixed total supply.
Constructor pre-allocates the whole supply in the balances mapping.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] with raw arithmetic that can underflow.
Unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply inside totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
transfer debits the caller-controlled msg.sender balance.
transferFrom reads and writes balances of the from and to accounts.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approve keys the allowance on the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transferFrom debits the allowance stored in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] for the caller.
allowance returns the allowed mapping entry.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall records an allowance for msg.sender and then transfers control to an attacker-controlled spender.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
transfer delegates balance arithmetic to safeSub.
transfer delegates balance arithmetic to safeAdd.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
approveAndCall hands control to the untrusted spender contract via receiveApproval.
The external call invokes the receiveApproval callback on the spender contract.
Owner can force an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract address.
